comparison.objective: Remove an internal obstruction, then fully screw a jar lid on.
comparison.physical_skill: Unscrewing, emptying, rethreading, and torque-limited closure.
comparison.success_condition: Lid removed, block extracted, lid rethreaded and seated; forcing, tipping, or skipping removal scores zero.
comparison.reason: Jar rethreading and terminal closure do not retain a continuous adjustment against a separate jam nut.
